summary: Validator for plan_id toolchain-workflow-repair; requires plan under execution-plans with 14 named artifacts; validates self-hosted contract, slices W0-W6, TDD intents, command registry (plan-ready, terminal-full, w0-w6 green/terminal), authority partitions, lifecycle state and publication receipt; supports initial-plan-ready and authorized-repair-revalidate modes; requires canonical skill-input receipt inside plan and ready validation; binds pre-existing delta to baseline 2556ea78f41657e5a740016ff97da0b0614631ea and candidate a2ded39b0f67dcbe5f27acedb56c0bafbd3f3fc5 with exact path set and SHA256/disposition checks; requires accepted architecture decisions, empty authorizations, resume slice set, knowledge preflight ready/freeze no authorization, accepted modules skill-input-execution and knowledge-execution-gates; emits pass/fail receipt and optional validator-input manifest with hashes; exits 0 only on no failures.
